# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment documents generated during analysis.

## Available Documents

- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - Endpoint inventory and service communication contracts.
- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - Application and component architecture diagrams.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Primary business workflows and sequence diagram.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, profiles, and secrets inventory.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Persistence, data model, and ownership boundaries.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - External dependency categories and compatibility notes.
